LESSON: GUIDED READING: VOCABULARY BUILDING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading Aloud: Grade Appropriate Texts (2 sessions) • Reading speed 
Topic 2.9: Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building, part of Reading 2.7 Reading Aloud: Grade Appropriate Texts (2 sessions) • Reading speed  in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why do we need to keep household items safely? 2. How does vocabulary building help in Arabic language acquisition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaborate with peers to select thematic words from a text based on the theme,

2. conduct a reading session to read the selected words,

3. team up to participate in reading circles by reading aloud words on location of household items,

4. work with peers to prepare a vocabulary bank on words based on the theme,

5. collaborate with peers to write the vocabulary on flashcards for display. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaborate with peers to select thematic words from a text based on the theme,
2. conduct a reading session to read the selected words,
3. team up to participate in reading circles by reading aloud words on location of household items,
4. work with peers to prepare a vocabulary bank on words based on the theme,
5. collaborate with peers to write the vocabulary on flashcards for display. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner acquires fluency in reading by reading aloud thematic

words.

• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced as the learner builds on their group work skills when participating in reading sessions

confidently.

38

Values:
Unity: This is promoted as the learner displays a team spirit while collaborating with peers to prepare a vocabulary bank on

words related to the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as the learner works together with peers to develop a reading culture by participating in

reading circles and reading sessions.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to link the concept on vocabulary building for language acquisition to their learning of similar concepts in

English and Kiswahili.

39
